audit.whatIsWrong: win[] and phases[].side gave Gangplank level 1 and gave Gwen level 3, the reverse of whys[0] and whys[2].
audit.why: At level 1 he has no Powder Keg and a mana-hungry Parrrley; Gwen's E-into-Q is a free trade. At 3 the keg chain is online and out-ranges her entirely. The prose says both plainly.
audit.corrected: Gwen / Skill / Gangplank / Gwen / Gangplank / Gwen / Gwen.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere, including for Remove Scurvy, which the page tells you to play around four separate times.
audit.why: Remove Scurvy is 22/20/18/16/14 and Cannon Barrage 160/140/120, against Needlework at 120s and Hallowed Mist at 22s. A 22-second cleanse means your Needlework slow only sticks if you check that clock first - that is the concrete version of 'Remove Scurvy cleanses your slow'.
audit.corrected: early, whys[2] and wants.foe[1] now carry the 22s figure; late names the 160s Cannon Barrage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Remove Scurvy's self-heal is never stated and Cannon Barrage's true damage is never stated.
audit.why: Remove Scurvy carries the heal flag, so it is not only a cleanse - it undoes chip as well, which is why poking him down before an all-in does not work. Cannon Barrage carries trueDamage and global flags, so the magic-resist-and-armour framing the rest of the page uses does not apply to his ultimate, and stacking resistances against it is the wrong answer.
audit.corrected: late and wants.foe[1] now name the heal and the anti-heal buy; late names Cannon Barrage's true damage.

audit.why: Remove Scurvy heals on a 22s cooldown, so Grievous Wounds is what makes the melee duel the page tells you to force actually decisive.
audit.corrected: late and whys[6] now name it.

edits.before: Gangplank has nothing at level 1 — no Powder Keg, and a mana-hungry, slow Parrrley last-hit — so step up with Skip 'n Slash into Snip Snip! for a free %-max-HP trade before his poke pattern exists. The lane flips at 3 when the keg comes online: a barrel placed and popped by Parrrley chunks you from outside your range, and Remove Scurvy cleanses any Needlework slow you land to set up the kill. Stop facetanking kegs to last-hit — walk wide of the barrel, soak the cannon with the tip of Snip Snip!, and don't waste Skip 'n Slash chasing a poke you can't catch.
edits.after: Gangplank has nothing at level 1 — no Powder Keg, and a mana-hungry, slow Parrrley last-hit — so step up with Skip 'n Slash into Snip Snip! for a free %-max-HP trade before his poke pattern exists. The lane flips at 3 when the keg comes online: a barrel placed and popped by Parrrley chunks you from outside your range, and Remove Scurvy, 22s at rank 1, cleanses any Needlework slow you land and heals him besides. Stop facetanking kegs to last-hit — walk wide of the barrel, soak the cannon with the tip of Snip Snip!, and do not chase a poke you cannot catch.

edits.before: Your Nashor's/Riftmaker spike is where you take over — %-max-HP Snip Snip! plus Hallowed Mist untargetability means you win every extended duel he tries to set up with kegs, and Remove Scurvy can't out-sustain your Thousand Cuts heal once you're in his face. He's a global scaler, so close the lane and snowball before his crit barrels and Cannon Barrage start swinging fights across the map. In teamfights, dash onto him through the chaos and stand in your mist on his keg detonations — you out-duel him as long as you reach melee, so never let him kite you in the open.
edits.after: Your Nashor's/Riftmaker spike is where you take over — %-max-HP Snip Snip! plus Hallowed Mist untargetability wins every extended duel he sets up with kegs, and with Grievous Wounds his 22s Remove Scurvy stops undoing the chip and healing him back once you are in his face. He is a global scaler, so close the lane before crit barrels and a 160s Cannon Barrage start swinging fights across the map — and note that Barrage deals true damage, so no amount of resistances answers it. In fights, dash onto him and stand in your mist on his keg detonations; never let him kite you in the open.

edits.before: His Powder Keg chain detonated by Parrrley is fully online — he pokes you from outside autorange and Remove Scurvy cleanses your Needlework slow before you reach him.
edits.after: His Powder Keg chain detonated by Parrrley is fully online — he pokes from outside autorange and a 22s Remove Scurvy cleanses your slow and heals him before you reach him.

edits.before: You shred him faster than Remove Scurvy can heal once you're in melee range, so close the lane and snowball before his crit barrels and Cannon Barrage scale.
edits.after: With Grievous Wounds you shred him faster than Remove Scurvy can heal once you are in melee, so close the lane before crit barrels and Cannon Barrage scale.

edits.before: Use Remove Scurvy to cleanse your Needlework slow and self-heal, then walk out of your melee threat and keep last-hitting safely
edits.after: Use a 22s Remove Scurvy to cleanse your Needlework slow and heal the chip off, then walk out of your melee threat and keep farming

notes: Prose is second-person and the ability names are all correct. Two fixes. (1) The chart disagreed with the prose at levels 1 and 3: whys[0] says your Skip 'n Slash into Snip Snip! lands a free trade he cannot answer, and whys[2] says his Powder Keg chain is fully online and pokes you from outside autorange - the chart had those backwards. Corrected to Gwen/Skill/Gangplank/Gwen/Gangplank/Gwen/Gwen. (2) Remove Scurvy is named four times as the thing that cleanses your Needlework slow, but the page never says it also HEALS him, and never names an anti-heal item; it is 22s at rank 1, which is the actual clock your slow has to beat. Cannon Barrage deals true damage, so 'he cannot break your resistances' reasoning does not apply to his ult - added. 'Thousand Cuts' was missing its 'A'.
